3. Use redstone to craft 1 dispenser using 1 redstone, 7 cobblestone, 1 bow.
4. Since we need cobblestone for the piston, obtain 7 cobblestone.

6. Craft 1 piston using 1 redstone, 4 cobblestone, 3 planks, 1 iron ingot.

1. Gather 4 oak logs to craft 4 oak planks.
2. Gather redstone.

4. Obtain 7 more cobblestone.
5. Gather 2 iron ingots.
6. Craft the piston using the following materials: 1 redstone, 4 cobblestone, 3 oak planks (crafted in step 1), and 1 iron ingot.

This sequence ensures that we have all the necessary raw materials to craft a piston.
